description: Pattern-based prevention rules for rjl-zombie-plains (Robo-Z) — TypeScript + Canvas survivor game

rules.name: Upgrade types defined without UI screen
rules.message: Upgrade type definitions exist but no upgrade selection UI screen was found — players cannot choose upgrades
rules.suggestion: Add an upgrade selection screen component that renders when the player levels up

rules.name: Game project with no audio system
rules.message: No audio system detected — game has no sound effects or music
rules.suggestion: Add an audio manager using Web Audio API or Howler.js for sound effects and music

rules.name: Game state without persistence
rules.message: Game state class has no save/load persistence — progress is lost on refresh
rules.suggestion: Implement save/load using localStorage: saveState() { localStorage.setItem('save', JSON.stringify(this.state)) }

rules.name: Survivor game without meta-progression
rules.message: Game with roguelike/survivor loop detected but no meta-progression system found — no persistent unlocks across runs
rules.suggestion: Add meta-progression: persistent currency earned per run, unlock tree, or prestige system saved to localStorage

rules.name: Repo name / in-game title mismatch
rules.message: In-game title 'Robo-Z' does not match repo name 'rjl-zombie-plains' — identity mismatch
rules.suggestion: Rename the repo to match the in-game title, or update the in-game title to match the repo name

rules.name: TypeScript: any type in game code
rules.message: Usage of 'any' type in game source code defeats TypeScript's type safety
rules.suggestion: Define proper interfaces for game entities, components, and state

rules.name: Canvas game without delta time
rules.message: Canvas game loop without delta time — physics will be framerate-dependent
rules.suggestion: Use delta time in game loop: const dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000; update(dt); render();

rules.name: setTimeout for game loop timing
rules.message: setTimeout used for game timing — use requestAnimationFrame or fixed timestep accumulator instead
rules.suggestion: Use requestAnimationFrame for rendering and a fixed timestep accumulator for game logic updates
